thread:
rachel: Ran into Deno + Bun issues with the JS SDK sample. Deno throws an ESM/CJS export error; Bun fails on `crypto.randomBytes`.
tom: Looks like package.json exports default to CJS and some utils import `node:crypto`. Need an ESM build and web-crypto fallback.
yue: Quick repro: `import { Client } from 'redwood'` -> Deno: [1mUncaught SyntaxError[0m: requested module '.../dist/index.cjs' does not provide export named 'Client'.
ci-bot: Issue created #1530: deno-bun-compat. Labels: devex, sdk-js.
tom: Action items: 1) add dist/esm entrypoint, 2) update package.exports with conditional import/require and browser fields, 3) change crypto helper to prefer globalThis.crypto.subtle then node fallback, 4) replace Buffer in public typings with Uint8Array union.
yue: For Bun fetch/streams we should guard `response.body?.getReader` and fallback to arrayBuffer. Also document Deno flags (`--allow-env`).
rachel: Can we add small examples: examples/deno/simple.ts and examples/bun/simple.ts and run deno/bun jobs in CI? That would catch regressions.
tom: I'll open a small PR that publishes ESM and adds a runtime feature-detect helper. Follow-ups: types cleanup and README compat matrix.
yue: Adding short polyfill snippet to examples to help partners who can't upgrade their runtime.
ci-bot: CI checklist updated to run deno:stable and bun:latest smoke tests.
